basic_info.description: Charming Fixer-Upper in Desirable Forest Hill Extension        Nestled in the highly sought-after Forest Hill Extension, this 3-bedroom single-family home presents an incredible opportunity to create your dream space in a prime location. Surrounded by top-rated schools, vibrant restaurants, boutique shops, and convenient transit access, this home offers both charm and potential.    This residence is ready for your vision to shine. Whether you're looking to renovate or refresh, the generous layout and inviting atmosphere provides the perfect canvas.    Enjoy a private backyard, ideal for relaxation or entertaining, along with the convenience of an attached two-car garage offering ample parking and storage.    Don't miss this chance to customize a home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!
